celebration.title: Your private chat recap keeps getting smarter
celebration.description: From evolving moods to personalized chat moments, WhatsAnalyze Wrapped mirrors everything fans love about Spotify's experience-built for the messages that define your friendships.

items.title: Chat Evolution Timeline
items.description: Track how your moods, pacing, and emoji vocabulary changed month over month. Watch phases appear just like Spotify's Music Evolution — now for your conversations.

items.title: Relationship Spotlight
items.description: Reveal your longest conversation streak-style insights for messaging. Identify who kept conversations alive and what percentile fan you are for every friend.

items.title: Message Evolution
items.description: Generate a curated queue of chats, insights, or moments that match each chat phase. Every card links back to the exact moment in your exported data.

items.title: Chat highlights that tell your story

exportGuide.title: How to export your WhatsApp chat?
iosSteps: Open WhatsApp and go to the chat you want to export
Tap on the chat name at the top
Select how you want to share the file (Email, iCloud Drive, etc.)
Select your file and follow the prompts to export
Share the exported .txt file with WhatsApp Wrapped
androidSteps: Open WhatsApp and long-press on the chat you want to export
Select how you want to share the file
Share the exported .txt file with WhatsApp Wrapped

info.title: Handle large exports on a computer
info.description: WhatsAnalyze processes everything locally in your browser, so huge TXT or ZIP exports can slow down phones. For smoother processing, send the exported file to your computer first and run the analysis there.

wrappedAboutPoints:
We are a group of friends with a shared passion for technology and curiosity about human communication. After years of intense WhatsApp usage, we wanted to understand how our conversations and relationships changed over time.

As computer scientists we wanted more than raw statistics—we wanted a tool that unites privacy and curiosity. That idea became WhatsAnalyze: a fully local, privacy-first solution that delivers meaningful insights without sharing personal information.

A tool by users, for users—transparent, secure, and crafted with care.
